leptogenesis-cp-asymmetry-decay-rate-721.title: Leptonic CP Asymmetry

astrophysical-euler-momentum-ident-4051a.limits_and_boundary: In the stationary limit ($\\mathbf{v} = 0$), this reduces to the equation of hydrostatic equilibrium.

metric-determinant-divergence-ident-c1c1.title: Metric-Determinant Divergence Relation

metric-determinant-divergence-ident-c1c1.limits_and_boundary: Allows for the direct integration of conservation laws over curved hypersurfaces.
